newsitem.title: POLAND: Kety to buy stakes in aluminium producers.
newsitem.headline: Kety to buy stakes in aluminium producers.

text.p: Polish aluminium plant Kety SA plans to buy stakes in several aluminium producers to strengthen its position on the market, the president of the company said on Wednesday.

"We plan to purchase stakes in firms producing aluminium as we want to strengthen our position on the market, especially in two sectors - construction and car industry," Jan Kryjak told Reuters, but declined to name the firms involved.
Kryjak also said the company's shareholders would decide on December 23 on a four-for-one share split.
Earlier the firm also said it wanted to issue new shares or convertible bonds, but Kryjak said no decision had yet been made.
He also said the company expected its net profit to rise to 30 million zlotys on sales of 400 million zlotys, up from last year's 23.8 million and 377.1 million respectively.
In the January-October period Kety's net profit amounted to 25.2 million on sales of 322.8 million.
